desc: Strong, durable, dependable, and versatile - the perfect small bore single-action revolver for plinking, small game hunting, or serious competition. Single-Nines are chambered in 22 Magnum and have a nine-round capacity. The Adjustable Williams fiber-optic sights utilize a square post and square notch configuration. The grips are made of hardwood and offer a slim "Gunfighter" feel. Comes with a hard plastic case.
